notes.text: I-app manje isikhuluma isiRashiya nesi-Ukraine: khetha "Русский" noma "Українська" ku-Iphrofayela › Ulimi, noma uyivumele ilandele idivayisi yakho.
Amaqembu manje angahlukanisa nge-ruble yaseRashiya (RUB) nange-hryvnia yase-Ukraine (UAH), futhi iqembu elakhiwe eRashiya noma e-Ukraine liqala ngohlobo lwemali yakhona.

I-Iphrofayela inokuncamelayo okusha, "Ifomethi yesikhathi": landela isistimu, noma ubonise njalo izikhathi ngamahora angu-24 (14:30) noma angu-12 nge-AM ne-PM (2:30 PM), ezindlekweni, ku-Umsebenzi, emazwaneni nakusikhethi sesikhathi.
Lapho ifoni ilele phansi, nakumathebhulethi, ukuthi "Hlukanisa isindleko" seqembu manje kuhlala kubha engenhla esikhundleni sokuntanta phezu kwezindleko.
Uma Imibala eguquguqukayo ivuliwe, lokho okufanele ukukhokhe kuhlala kusawolintshi esikhundleni sokuba bomvu, ukuze kungalokothi kubukeke njengoluhlaza lwalokho okubuyela kuwena.
Ku-Umsebenzi, umugqa ngamunye manje ubonisa isithombe seqembu eduze kwegama lalo, uma iqembu linaso.
Ibhalansi yakho kuleli qembu ayisaphindi inani emugqeni wesibili lapho uthola kuphela noma ukweleta kuphela.

Ku-Ukuhlukanisa okuzenzakalelayo, ingxenye yomuntu ngamunye yesindleko sesibonelo manje inombala wayo, nechashaza elifanayo ngaphambi kwegama lakhe, ukuze abantu abaseduze ohlwini bangalokothi babukeke njengomuntu oyedwa.
Ibha engenhla yesindleko manje ibonisa isithombe seqembu, noma izinhlamvu zalo zokuqala, eduze kwegama leqembu.
Ukuthepha isithombe somuntu manje kusiyisa ephrofayeleni yakhe, futhi kusibuyise lapho ubuyela emuva.
Isindleko esivulwe ku-Izindleko zeqembu manje singena endaweni yaso njengoba senza ku-Ikhaya, futhi isithombe seqembu ezindlekweni ze-Ikhaya sindizela kubha engenhla yesindleko.

Ukuthi "Hlukanisa isindleko" manje kukhona naphezulu ku-Amabhalansi naku-Oxhumana nabo, futhi esikrinini seqembu kudlulele kubha engenhla esikhundleni sokuntanta phezu kohlu, kanti ukuthi "Engeza abantu" manje kusemenyu ethi ⋯. Kuqala negama lakho bese kuncipha kube yisithonjana sakho njengoba uskrola.
Ku-Amaqembu, ukuthepha ikhadi le-Ibhalansi iyonke kuvula i-Amabhalansi.
Ukuthi "Mema abantu" eqenjini manje sekubizwa ngokuthi "Engeza abantu".

Ku-iPad, amathebhu avuleka kubha eseceleni, futhi lapho ehlala kubha engenhla, njengoba kunjalo uma i-iPad imile, ukuthi "Hlukanisa isindleko" kuhlala kubonakala lapho kuyilapho ezinye izinkinobho zidlulela emugqeni ongezansi nje.

Ku-"Hlukanisa isindleko", ukuthi "Kukhokhwe ngani" manje kuvela futhi lapho omunye umuntu ekhokhe isindleko, kufiphele: ukukuthepha kuchaza ukuthi labo abakhokhile kuphela abangamaka ukuthi bakhokhe ngani.

Ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti, ikhodi yakho yokubuyisela manje ingamagama angu-12 anezinombolo, okulula ukuwabhala phansi, futhi ukubuyisela kuwathatha igama elilodwa enkundleni ngayinye, kuphakamisa igama ngalinye njengoba uthayipha. Amakhodi alondolozwe ngaphambi kwale nguqulo awasasebenzi: londoloza entsha, noma uxhume i-Google noma i-Apple.
Ku-Izindleko ngesigaba, isindleko ngasinye manje sinemenyu efanayo ethi ⋮ njengasezindlekweni zeqembu: sihlele, siphinde, yabelana ngaso noma usisuse ngaphandle kokusivula.
Ezikrinini ezibanzi (ifoni ilele phansi, amathebhulethi, i-Mac newebhu), i-Izindleko ngesigaba igcina izigaba zayo nesamba kukholomu eseceleni kwezindleko.
NgesiJalimane, isiDashi nesiJaphani, imisho ye-Umsebenzi manje ifundeka ngokuhleleka kwamagama okwemvelo kolimi ngalunye, ngaphandle kwekholoni ngaphambi kwegama lesindleko noma leqembu.
Uhlamvu lokuqala lokuthi "Engeza isithombe" ngaphansi kokunamathiselwe kwesindleko alusanqunywa.
Ku-Amaqembu, inkinobho yokwakha iqembu manje ithi "+ Iqembu" futhi ayisahlukani ibe imigqa emibili.
I-Okusha manje ibonisa inguqulo osanda kuyifaka, esikhundleni sokulinda kuze kube usuku olulodwa ukuze kulethwe okusha kwayo.
Ku-Izibalo zeqembu, inkinobho yesikhathi ("Sonke isikhathi") ayisahlukani ibe imigqa emibili: izinsuku zidlulela ngaphansi kwayo lapho zombili zingangeni.
